name: composure
description: An open-source, self-hostable collaborative document editor for researchers and technical writers.

scripts.db:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.db.yml up -d --wait db
scripts.db:reset: bash scripts/psql.sh "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS composure WITH (FORCE);" && bash scripts/psql.sh "CREATE DATABASE composure;"
scripts.db:reset:test: bash scripts/psql.sh "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS composure_test WITH (FORCE);" && bash scripts/psql.sh "CREATE DATABASE composure_test;"
scripts.db:nuke: npm run db:down && docker volume rm composure_pgdata
scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:compiler:1" "npm run dev:compiler:2"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=frontend && npm run build --workspace=backend
